recent.text: On a very special night, the Mammoth managed to shut down a very good Ducks offense and win with only 12 shots on net. Here's how they pulled off a very unlikely victory. #TusksUp https://t.co/3UohAnyoQ7
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: After standing on his head in back-to-back victories, Cossa has done more than enough to earn the crease. Until further notice, the net belongs to the rookie. More here ⬇️ https://t.co/z3hoE9pRQJ
recent.author: Cole Bagley

recent.text: Postgame Notes - 11/21 vs. ANA: – Sebastian Cossa (29/31) joined Jesper Wallstedt (MIN, 11/14 at BOS) as the second goaltender to record a win on his birthday in 2026-27. – Utah's 12 shots on goal tonight were the fewest by any team in a win since 3/22/25 (NYR, 12 SOG vs. VAN). https://t.co/eXGLD6yKkA
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME "Really good win. Hard game, energy-wise. I think our guys battled really hard. We had good goaltending. Best power play in the league on the other side, and the PK (Penalty Kill) was clutch at key moments." @utahmammoth André Tourigny on tonight's win https://t.co/4NP7vRalT0
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME "I think our team did a really good job on the [penalty kill]. Big kill there, ten minutes left in the third up one... We did a really good job." @utahmammoth Sebastian Cossa on tonight's effort https://t.co/uHH6hlzFpg
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: POSTGAME "Tonight, the way we battled down there, physicality, blocking shots, keeping things to the outside, not letting them get to the middle. Those were big things for us." @utahmammoth Andrew Peeke on defensive details in Utah's effort https://t.co/aCwxJWearh
recent.author: Utah Mammoth PR

recent.text: High fives all around! #TusksUp https://t.co/exkWaCWD2e

recent.text: André Tourigny on Vincent Trocheck's leadership: "He is one of the guys who stepped up on the bench and said ‘ok, it’s not the type of game in front of us right now, guys. We need to play the right way.’ I think the guys responded well to him and they made the right adjustment."
recent.author: Catherine Bogart

recent.text: Someway, somehow Utah finished with 6/10 points on this home stand. These last two wins were huge. Lots of guys stepping up despite injuries. Cossa was spectacular with 59 saves on 62 shots (.951 SV%) over the last two.
recent.author: Cole Bagley

recent.text: A birthday win for Cossa! 🥳 @SCMerrifield | @ZionsBank https://t.co/ReTLLzo0Rg
recent.author: Utah Mammoth

recent.text: Boys held it down tonight! #tusksup
recent.author: Ryan Smith

recent.text: Final: Mammoth: 3, Ducks: 2. Second straight win for Utah. Not a lot of offense, and in any other game, that would likely be a problem. However, the Mammoth's defense and Sebastian Cossa held strong and shut down the Ducks' most prized weapon: their offense. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Utah wins the hockey game 3-2! Unreal to win with only 12 SOG. Cossa stood on his head again.
recent.author: Cole Bagley

recent.text: Salt Lake City native Ian Moore scores from near the blueline to cut the lead again to one with 11.3 seconds remaining. 3-2 Mammoth. #TusksUp
recent.author: Chase Beardsley

recent.text: Utah holds on for the win. It began as a nightmare of a roadtrip, but Utah is suddenly 2-1-2 in that span. Final score: 3-2 UTA #TusksUp #FlyTogether
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: Anaheim scores with 10.5 left on the clock. Cooley's goal will make a difference here. 3-2, UTA still leads #TusksUp #FlyTogether
recent.author: Brogan Houston

recent.text: Logan Cooley deposits the puck into the empty net and likely seals the deal on this game. 3-1 Mammoth. #TusksUp
